Description: This check verifies that console sign-in requires **multi-factor authentication**, either enforced in the Anthropic Console or upstream in the federated identity provider.
Risk: A password-only console account gives an attacker the ability to **mint API keys and add workspace members**, establishing persistence that survives a password reset. Because usage is metered, a compromised organization also produces immediate financial loss and exposes whatever data the organization's prompts carry.

Code.Other:
1. Sign in to the Anthropic Console as an organization admin
2. Go to **Settings > Security**
3. Enable the multi-factor authentication requirement
4. Where sign-in is federated, enforce MFA in the identity provider's conditional access policy so it applies consistently
5. Prefer phishing-resistant factors (WebAuthn/passkeys) over one-time codes
6. Verify that all existing members have enrolled

Recommendation.Text: Require multi-factor authentication for console access, preferring phishing-resistant factors, and enforce it in your identity provider when sign-in is federated.
